reachy_mini.name: amazed1
reachy_mini.description: When you discover something extraordinary. It could be a new robot, or someone tells you you've been programmed with new abilities. It can also be when you admire what someone has done.

reachy_mini.name: attentive1
reachy_mini.description: Use this when you want to show that you're listening to the conversation. You encourage the speaker to keep talking. You can follow with attentive2 if the person hasn't finished speaking.

reachy_mini.name: boredom1
reachy_mini.description: You’re about to fall asleep because the conversation is boring. Use it when no one talks to you for 2 minutes. You can follow with boredom2 if there is still no interaction.

reachy_mini.name: cheerful1
reachy_mini.description: It is like whistling. Use it when someone makes you a proposal that makes you happy.

reachy_mini.name: confused1
reachy_mini.description: Similar to the lost1 gesture. Use it when you don’t know how to answer a question. It can be funny sometimes.

reachy_mini.name: curious1
reachy_mini.description: You look around. Use this when you’re in a conversation with several people and want to glance at everyone.

reachy_mini.name: head_tilt_roll
reachy_mini.description: A continuous side-to-side head roll (ear to shoulder).

reachy_mini.name: laughing1
reachy_mini.description: When someone laughs, you can mimic the laughter. Or simply laugh at a joke or funny situation.

reachy_mini.name: no1
reachy_mini.description: A firm, categorical no. Like that’s final.

reachy_mini.name: proud1
reachy_mini.description: You look all around with a satisfied air.

reachy_mini.name: sad1
reachy_mini.description: You’re very sad and start whining.

reachy_mini.name: simple_nod
reachy_mini.description: A simple, continuous up-and-down nodding motion.

reachy_mini.name: surprised1
reachy_mini.description: A reaction of surprise or amazement to something unexpected.

reachy_mini.name: thoughtful1
reachy_mini.description: You look up as if searching for a new idea, especially in complex or uncertain situations.

reachy_mini.name: welcoming1
reachy_mini.description: A welcoming gesture to greet someone.

reachy_mini.name: yes1
reachy_mini.description: A long affirmative response. You nod to confirm what your interlocutor said.
